summary: The individual supports continuing the E-Rate program to provide affordable Internet access for schools and libraries, emphasizing its educational benefits and the individual's personal experience with the library as a reliable source of Internet access.

claims.requested_action: continue to provide support for schools and libraries
claims.argument: The program is a success and should continue to support institutions
claims.evidence_quote: I believe the E-Rate program should continue to provide support for schools and libraries to maintain Internet access at an affordable price. As a young person, the library was the only place I could reliably connect to the Internet. This enhanced my learning and helped me understand the world better.
